name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> game-function name. 'chapter_event_handler' = the per-event dispatch-table family @ 0x51B91. '49' is the dispatch-table index 0x49 (table entry @ 0x51CB5, verified as the sole xref-to), a meaningful domain ID like every sibling (handler_2f..4a), NOT an address residue (own address is 0x35C23). '__unref' records that no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook references this slot (verified: only xref is the dispatch table itself, get_function_callers returns none). '__sentinel' describes its category (consumed-flag setter only). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Unreferenced chapter-event dispatch slot 0x49: a sentinel handler that marks the ch28 sentinel-scene tile-event slot consumed (tile_event_consumed_flags[0x12] = 1) with no other side effects.
logic_summary: Single statement: store 1 into tile_event_consumed_flags[0x12]. In the binary it is a 10-byte stub (PUSH 4; CALL __CHK; JMP 0x35AAE) that borrows the Class-3 shared consume-slot-0x12 tail (MOV EAX,[consumed_flags_ptr]; MOV byte [EAX+0x12],1; RET) hosted at the end of fd2_chapter_event_handler_44__ch28_dialog_with_state @ 0x35A48 (alt_66 @ 0x35AAE). The __CHK(4) is the Watcom stack-probe prologue and carries no source-level semantics. Slot 0x12 is the prerequisite that the handler_44/handler_45 chain depends on. event_arg is never read.
